text: One week earlier… a young man went missing.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: His name was Takeshi Hongo. The brightest student in the biochemistry lab at Jonan University, he was also a formidable motocross racer.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: His motocross mentor, and the guardian of a young man with no family left in the world, was Tobei Tachibana…

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: While training at motocross with Tachibana, Hongo was attacked by a mysterious biker gang and abducted.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: And so, still unconscious, Hongo was brought to a place far from any town…

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: …Where the hell am I? Let me go!
speaker: Takeshi Hongo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Heh heh heh…

Takeshi Hongo… Welcome to our Shocker.
speaker: Mysterious Voice

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: …Shocker? What are you talking about?
speaker: Takeshi Hongo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: We are an evil secret society whose goal is to modify the people of the whole world and control them as we please!
speaker: Mysterious Voice

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: What kind of nonsense is that? More importantly, who are you!? Let me out of here!
speaker: Takeshi Hongo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
I am the great Leader of Shocker… the new ruler of the entire world.

Right now, I am speaking to you over a secret line from Shocker Headquarters, far away from where you are.
speaker: Mysterious Voice

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The Leader of Shocker?
speaker: Takeshi Hongo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The man we seek has an IQ of 600 and excels at every sport. You are a young man chosen for glory.
speaker: Shocker's Great Leader

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ridiculous…! I never agreed to join Shocker!
speaker: Takeshi Hongo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Heh heh heh… It's too late, Takeshi Hongo…

Regardless of your will, you have already all but become a member of Shocker.

A week has passed since you lost consciousness… In that time, Shocker's scientists have modified your body. You are now a cyborg!

Cyborgs will move the world, and I am the one who controls those cyborgs. The world will bend to my will!
speaker: Shocker's Great Leader

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A cyborg? Ha ha ha… As if I'd believe that!!
speaker: Takeshi Hongo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Heh heh heh… Then show him, so he has no choice but to believe!!
speaker: Shocker's Great Leader

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Yes, sir…

Injecting energy into Hongo's internal dynamo. You there, send in the wind!!
speaker: Shocker Scientist

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: …Good, stop!
speaker: Shocker Scientist

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
We will now run 50,000 volts through your body. An ordinary human would become a charred corpse in an instant.

But your modified body has stored up wind energy. Begin the discharge!!
speaker: Shocker Scientist

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Waaaaagh…
speaker: Takeshi Hongo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Not a single burn will remain on your body. The only reason you feel that pain is that your brain has not yet been modified.

Once the brain modification is done and you move only on command, you will become a perfect Shocker cyborg!!

…Good, stop the discharge!
speaker: Shocker Scientist

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ngh… I-I'd die before I became the man you bastards want!
speaker: Takeshi Hongo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Everyone thinks that at first… and in time, they come to be grateful that they are members of Shocker!

…Begin Takeshi Hongo's brain modification!!
speaker: Shocker Scientist

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: What's going on!?
speaker: Shocker Scientist

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An unidentified object, possibly a meteorite, has crashed! The impact knocked out the generator!
speaker: Shocker Combatant

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Damn it, at a time like this! We'll see to repairing the generator. …In any case, the operation is suspended!

Combatants, begin investigating that object at once!
speaker: Shocker Scientist

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
What is this…!?

A capsule for atmospheric entry? It doesn't seem to have any nationality marked on it… Where in the world is it from…?
speaker: Shocker Combatant

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Wh-what the!?
speaker: Shocker Combatant

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Wh-who are you!?
speaker: Shocker Combatant

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Looks like… we made it down to Earth safely?

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
[HERO2]… In this case, "safely" may not be the appropriate word.

Also… these Earthlings are a little different from the image I had from what you told me, [HERO2].

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
You've got that right… What's more, it looks like we're not welcome!

[HERO4]! Analyze these guys' biological structure.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Roger.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Scan complete!

Their bodies show clear traces of enhancement modification… They appear to be cyborgs, but it doesn't seem to have been done with Vol cells.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
In other words… cyborgs made without Vol?

Seems Earth has changed in these 15 years…

All right… Who did this, and where? I'm going to find out!

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
What are you jabbering about?

We won't forgive anyone who gets in Shocker's way! Get them!!
speaker: Shocker Combatant

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Damn it, if only I could get these chains off…
speaker: Takeshi Hongo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: …I tore through iron chains? Me? Have I really been turned into a cyborg!?
speaker: Takeshi Hongo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
…!?

Hey, Hongo's escaping! Send more combatants!
speaker: Shocker Combatant

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: That's right… This is no time to grieve! Whatever happens, I have to get out of here…
speaker: Takeshi Hongo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Takeshi Hongo! It's useless to try to escape!

Now, come back to Shocker. Otherwise, I'll kill you! Hoah, hoah, hoah…
speaker: Man Spider

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Shocker's pursuers…

Thanks to you bastards, I've ended up with power like a monster's…

But… I'll use this power to crush the schemes of you Shocker bastards!
speaker: Takeshi Hongo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Hoah, hoah, hoah… Takeshi Hongo! You mean to betray Shocker?
speaker: Man Spider

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Modified by you bastards, I'm no longer the Takeshi Hongo I used to be.

I'm a warrior of justice who'll crush Shocker's schemes… Kamen Rider!!
speaker: Takeshi Hongo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: [HERO2]… That appears to be a different type of cyborg.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Infighting among them? He doesn't seem like an ordinary human either.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
He has probably undergone modification surgery too…

But… it seems he hasn't undergone the brain modification yet. He alone clearly has a sense of self.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
A sense of self, huh…

So he's a cyborg… but he doesn't exist as a mere tool?

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Yes…

Just as you awakened to your own self and got yourself back, [HERO2], he too is resisting with everything he has…

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
We can't just leave him, can we?

All right… We're helping him, [HERO4]!

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Right!

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
…!?

Damn, reinforcements!

[HERO4]! Activate Fusion Steel! We'll take them all down at once!

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Roger!

Transmitting equip position coordinates to the command satellite!

Setting: "Gravity Combat." Armament: "Close Combat." Fusion Steel, activate!!

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Fusion Steel, equip!!

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
…!?

You transformed? Are you Shocker? Are you cyborgs too?
speaker: Kamen Rider

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: We'll talk later! For now, let's take care of these guys!
speaker: Lucifard

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
This is Gavan, advancing into the Solar System…

Near Jupiter, the Solar System's fifth planet, I've found the Galactic Union's S-class most wanted fugitive, Black Knight Lucifard!
speaker: Man in a Combat Suit

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Black Knight Lucifard?

Isn't he a top executive of the Battle Fleet Nation Naager, the space crime organization that manipulates all the evil in the universe from the shadows?

Gavan, will you be all right on your own?
speaker: Messenger from Planet Bird

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Yeah… He's a vicious opponent, all right, but now that I've found him, I have to do this!

Marine, if anything happens to me… tell Commander Kom to dispatch the Space Sheriff assigned to the Earth sector as my successor!
speaker: Space Sheriff Gavan

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Gavan…

All right! But be careful! Black Knight Lucifard is a dangerous man who wields the Fusion Steel…
speaker: Marine

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Thanks, Marine…

But I'll be fine. I'll show him the power of the super-dimensional high-speed ship Dolgiran! Let's go, Electronic Starbeast Dol!!
speaker: Space Sheriff Gavan

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The Galactic Union Police, founded with Planet Bird at its center to keep order and peace in the galaxy… dispatched officers wielding super-weapons to each star system.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: One such officer, known as a Space Sheriff, has now come to our Solar System. His name is Gavan. Space Sheriff Gavan!

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: You won't get away! Galactic Union S-class most wanted fugitive, Black Knight Lucifard!!
speaker: Space Sheriff Gavan

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Heh heh heh… A Space Sheriff, eh?

But… if you get in my way, you won't go home alive! Our Battle Fleet Nation Naager takes orders from no one!
speaker: Black Knight Lucifard

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: What!? What in the world are you people of the Battle Fleet Nation Naager plotting?
speaker: Space Sheriff Gavan

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Ha ha ha… I have no need to explain to the likes of you!

Our Battle Fleet Nation Naager, led by Steel Emperor Zephas, is the all-powerful, all-knowing creator!
speaker: Black Knight Lucifard

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Steel Emperor Zephas?
speaker: Space Sheriff Gavan

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
That's right…

Lord Zephas will give humanity warning, guide humanity, and make his will known to all creation!

Heh heh heh… This whole universe, and whether you live or die, lies entirely at Lord Zephas's will!
speaker: Black Knight Lucifard

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: What!? I won't allow such arrogance! Not while I, Space Sheriff Gavan, am here!!
speaker: Space Sheriff Gavan

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Ha ha ha, interesting… So you mean to defy us?

Fadita! Let's play with this man for a while!
speaker: Black Knight Lucifard

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Roger, Lucifard!
speaker: Fadita

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
…!?

His partner Fadita is with him too!?

Ngh… Bring it on! Here I come, Lucifard!
speaker: Space Sheriff Gavan

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Have at you, Space Sheriff Gavan!!
speaker: Black Knight Lucifard

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The battle between Lucifard and Gavan was fierce in the extreme… the struggle swung back and forth on and on.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: But the tightly coordinated attacks of Lucifard and Fadita gradually began to push Gavan back… Even Dol, whom he relied on, began to show heavy damage.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ngh, this is bad… At this rate, I'll be finished. I have to find some opening, any opening!
speaker: Space Sheriff Gavan

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Space Sheriff…

Gavan, was it? To give me this much trouble… you're quite something…

But this is the end! Fusion Steel, maximum output!!
speaker: Black Knight Lucifard

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Roar!! Bullet of gravitons! Gravity Napalm!!

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
…!?

Ngh, Dol Laser!!
speaker: Space Sheriff Gavan

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Uoooooh!!
speaker: Space Sheriff Gavan

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: What!?
speaker: Black Knight Lucifard

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
Ugh, nngh…

…I'm alive? Did I win…? Where is he? Where's Lucifard…?
speaker: Space Sheriff Gavan

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
…He's gone?

But… I definitely felt that hit land.

Still, Dolgiran and I are both in tatters. I can't chase him any further. I'll have to head back to Planet Bird for now…
speaker: Space Sheriff Gavan

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: …Lucifard! Lucifard!
speaker: Fadita

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ughhh…
speaker: Lucifard

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Vital signs weak… Fusion Steel shifting to life-support mode.
speaker: Fadita

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
No… S-stop it!

Brother, Sister… …Ngh… nngh… Stop it, Father!!
speaker: Lucifard

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text:
…Abnormal brainwave activity detected! Lucifard, hang on! Lucifard!!

…[HERO2]!!
speaker: Fadita

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Humanity still knows nothing of this battle fought in Jupiter's orbit. Nor that it was the prologue to Earth's greatest crisis…

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Soon after, two shooting stars streaked from Jupiter toward Earth… And now, the battle has begun!

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Curse you, Takeshi Hongo… no, Kamen Rider! To think you would defy our Shocker…

text: Type 01 Beam Gun

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An anti-kaiju, anti-robot beam weapon developed by the full might of the Defense Force's scientists. It burns its target with the thermal effect of a neutral particle beam. The twin turrets aim at the same target and fire alternately in bursts, which also allows mechanical destruction. Besides the main guns, it carries beam guns for anti-air fire.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A weapon that can only be developed once Dr. Kuroda joins.

text: Type 75 SP Howitzer

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A self-propelled howitzer operated by the Defense Force ground troops. Length 10.7 m, top speed 54 km/h. Armed with a 203mm howitzer with automatic feeding and loading. Upgraded by Dr. Sahara, after which it can be mass-produced.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Type 87 AA Gun

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Belongs to the Defense Force ground troops. Armed with two 35mm anti-aircraft cannons, it mainly provides air-defense cover. Length 7.99 m, top speed 53 km/h. The cannons can be elevated and turned to ground attack as well. A weapon upgraded once Dr. Kuroda joins, after which it can be mass-produced.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Type 89 IFV

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An armored fighting vehicle able to transport troops. Length 6.8 m, top speed 70 km/h. Armed with a 35mm cannon, a 7.62mm machine gun and anti-tank guided missiles. Upgraded by Dr. Sahara, after which it can be mass-produced. It can carry four S-size units and transport them

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: quickly to their destination.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Type 90 Tank

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The main battle tank of the Defense Force ground troops. Length 9.8 m, top speed 70 km/h. Armed with a 120mm smoothbore gun, a 12.7mm M2 heavy machine gun and more. Modified by Dr. Namikawa to fire special anti-kaiju shells, after which it can be mass-produced.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: AH-1S Attack Heli

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An attack helicopter operated by the Defense Force ground troops. It carries both ground-attack and anti-air weapons. Length 16.16 m. Engine type T53-K-703. Top speed 315 km/h. Upgraded once Dr. Tsuchida joins, after which it can be mass-produced.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: BF Chief

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A subordinate of Spider, the first head of BF's Japan branch. He directly commands the BF members in the field. Since he commands BF members who start a game of poker at the slightest excuse, his worries may never end.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: CH-47J Transport Heli

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An all-weather tandem-rotor transport helicopter. It boasts flexible operation in all kinds of environments and high survivability in combat, and can carry up to 55 personnel. Length 30.18 m, cruising speed 250 km/h. In the game it can transport four S-size units.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: F-15J Kai

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A high-mobility interceptor used by the Defense Force as the successor to the F-15J. Canards on the front of the fuselage allow advanced maneuvering combat. Crew of 2, length 19.4 m, top speed Mach 2. Armed with a 20mm cannon, missiles and bombs. Strengthened beyond the standard model by Dr. Tsuchida, it can be mass-produced

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: once he joins.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text
aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The next-generation support fighter, intended to repel airspace intruders and support ground and sea forces. A newly deployed aircraft whose mobility and stability surpass the American F-16C it was based on. Length 15.52 m, top speed Mach 2. Armed with cannons, missiles and more. Upgraded by Dr. Namikawa, after which it can be mass-produced.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: GR2

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Developed by BF, its official name is Giant Robo No. 2. It attacks by launching its horns and hands, can even launch its own head, and fires laser beams from its eyes. Its power equals Robo's, but its performance is somewhat inferior.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: NAAGER

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A giant space exploration ship built on the far side of the Moon by Kiichi Sakomizu, former Director of SIDO, who had long loudly warned SIDO and the TDF about threats from outer space. Some say it carried enough weaponry to call it a fortress ship. Kiichi Sakomizu himself took command and attempted the closest approach to Number Ten, but communications broke off there and the ship went missing. This

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: accident was covered up by the TDF, and few know the truth.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: VOL

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: When Number Ten appeared at the outer edge of the solar system and Earth's scientists were in an uproar, Dr. Hinata, a former TDF science staff member, suggested that Number Ten itself might be a life form, and gave this provisional name to its cells. VOL is short for "Vagarious Outer Life", meaning something like "wandering life from outer space". It is said to be a hypothesis based on reports from Ryoma and Ryoko Sakomizu,

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: who were aboard the NAAGER, but the truth is unclear. Because the doctor submitted this hypothesis, he was driven out of the TDF. There are signs that Dr. Hinata continued basic research on these cells after leaving, and that, to prove his hypothesis using a sample found at Nojimazaki, he knowingly carried out forbidden and dangerous

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: clinical trials on his own laboratory staff. VOL is a type of archaebacterial cell that cannot reproduce on its own and lives as a parasite in a host. Once it begins to multiply, it rapidly assimilates the host's eukaryotic cells and replaces them. Higher organisms assimilated by the Vol whose bodies have transformed are called EATERs.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Iron Rocks

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A battleship robot built by the Mimi Aliens from the scrap iron of warships sleeping on the seabed. It bombards with many cannons and stops enemies with giant handcuffs. It is set to self-destruct 15 minutes after shutting down. Length 80 m, weight 1,500 t. In the game, destroying it yields a lot of Materials.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Aorenger

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: One of the five warriors of the International Secret Defense Organization EAGLE's Japan branch. Akira Shinmei transforms into him. His weapons include the Blue Cherry and the Ultra Blue Cherry. He also handles piloting the mecha.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Akarenger

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: One of the five warriors of the International Secret Defense Organization EAGLE's Japan branch, and the leader of Gorenger. Tsuyoshi Kaijo transforms into him. His weapons include the Red Bute, a whip that can change into many forms, and the Silver Shot tranquilizer gun.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Soichiro Akizuki

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An archaeologist. Nobuhiko Akizuki's real father and Kotaro Minami's foster father. He was actually a member of the dark society Gorgom and handed the two over to Gorgom as Century Kings, but on learning their memories would be erased, he tried to save them at the last moment.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Nobuhiko Akizuki

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kotaro Minami's best friend, kidnapped by Gorgom and remodeled at the same time as him. He transforms into Shadow Moon and commands Gorgom. He keeps his human memories, but his personality has become cold and cruel.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Akira

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Son of Professor Gill and younger brother of Hiroshi. Half of the blueprints for the giant robot Giant Devil are recorded on his back, and Shadow relentlessly hunts him for that secret. The blueprints on his back appear when light reflects off it. Worn down by life on the run, he once tearfully pleaded with Jiro.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Agira

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: One of the three Capsule Monsters owned by Dan Moroboshi. Smart and agile, it excels at attacking with its horn. It comes from the Animal Planet.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Acrobatter

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A light-mobile life form reborn and evolved from the Battle Hopper by the sun's life energy. It has a will of its own and boasts a top speed of 750 km/h. It can also transform into the Roboizer and the Mackjaber to match RX's forms. Its Acrobat Burn, a body slam at top speed, is devastating.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kenji Asuka

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The sole survivor of EAGLE's Kansai branch, which was wiped out by Poison Gas Mask. He is the youngest member, but he can talk with animals. He transforms into Midorenger.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Atefarina

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Fusion Steel Shell Type S: Atefarina. The Fusion Steel shell exclusive to Atefarina the Battle Princess. Type S is a speed-focused specification, and the ion craft at its waist gives it astonishing speed. Incidentally, Ryoko's personality seems to change completely when she dons the Fusion Steel shell. Weapons include the Plasma Web.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Annie

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A female Space Sheriff and Shaider's partner, from the 16th squad of the training academy. Her home planet, Mount in the Great Orion Nebula M47, was destroyed by Fuuma. An expert with the Birdnia Blaster, and good at disguises too.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Apfaron

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Fusion Steel Shell Type H: Apfaron. The Fusion Steel shell exclusive to Apfaron the Evil Scholar. A Type H specification built for "mass slaughter: holocaust", it has plants inside its body that produce every kind of poison, and can turn an Earth-sized planet into a dead world in a week. It also has excellent search and scanning functions, and instantly

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: finds out an opponent's weak points. Its weapons are the Acid Needle and Acid Mist.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Amagi

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Good with numbers, he is an authority on electronic computers and a skilled planner. He is a little timid, but extremely gentle by nature. His hobby is photography. He is from Nagoya.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Amamoto

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A UCMA unit member. Excels at indirect attacks.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Suspicious Man

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A mysterious man who transformed into a white balloon and kept watch on Den Iga wherever he went. He is really Psycholer in human form, also called the Cultivator.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Makoto Arai

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A secret agent of Interpol. He warned Goro Watari about the threat of the Desper Army and fights alongside him. In fact his body has been turned into a cyborg, and his wife and child are held captive in Desper City.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Dr. Araki

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A scientist who designed an auxiliary circuit with almost the same performance as the Conscience Circuit developed by Dr. Komyoji. Targeted by Dark for his secret, he hid it in the red shoes of his daughter Taeko. In the game he later joins the TDF science group and handles development of the "Zone Canceller" and "Hyper Maneuver L".

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Arashi

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A tough guy and expert marksman who easily handles the 3 kg Spider Shot. He has a strong sense of responsibility and is brave and daring. His real name is Daisuke Arashi. In the game he is the only one who can use the Spider Shot.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Aron

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A strongman kaiju. A decoy that the Alien Guts made fight in order to study Ultraseven's abilities and weaknesses. It has a long tail and giant wings, but no particular attack abilities. Height 45 m, weight 13,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ando

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A UCMA unit member. Especially strong in direct attacks.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Androidman

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Dark's combat machine soldiers. Armed with naginata, they attack in groups. They operate behind the scenes in cars with "He-9999" plates.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ika-Devil

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form Doctor Death himself transformed into. He tried to drop meteorites onto Earth with the control device on his head. He can also seal away the Rider Kick with his "Kick Killer". His weapons are the freely extending whips on both hands.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Den Iga

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A former forest patrol member. Gravely wounded in an attack by Makuu, he was saved by Gavan and resolved to fight the evil of space. After finishing his training, he becomes the second Space Sheriff, Sharivan, and fights the space crime syndicate Madou. He is actually a descendant of the destroyed Planet Iga.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Retsu Ichijouji

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: From Planet Bird. Born to the Space Sheriff Voicer and an Earth mother, Tamiko Ichijouji. He equips the Combat Suit with "Johchaku", becomes Space Sheriff Gavan, and fights the space crime organization Makuu. He searches for his father Voicer, who disappeared after being betrayed by a comrade.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Hayato Ichimonji

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A freelance photographer with a 6th-dan in judo and a 5th-dan in karate. Shocker remodeled him to fight Rider No. 1, but No. 1 rescued him before his brain was altered, and they began fighting Shocker together.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ichiro

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An android Dr. Komyoji completed before Kikaider. He rides the Double Machine and appears to the sound of a white trumpet.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Itsutsu Banbara

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The first Mutant Robo of the Phantom Army. It has five faces and burns down towns with "Fire Pillar", spewing red and blue flames. It also has abilities such as "Fissure Quake", which causes a magnitude-6 earthquake.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ide

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A genius inventing maniac who developed most of the Science Patrol's weapons, such as the kaiju translator, the Mars 133 and the QX Gun. He is also the Science Patrol's joker. His real name is Mitsuhiro Ide.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Inazuman

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Inazuman Flash

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Inazuman with new power gained from the "Zeber", made by fusing his own eyes and antennae, in order to fight the new enemy, the Desper Army. The Zeber can also be used as a weapon, and the time needed to transform with "Choriki, Shorai" is shortened.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Dr. Iwamoto

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A scientist who cooperates with the Science Patrol. A calm man of fine character who developed the Jet VTOL and the hydrogenate rocket engine. When he joins the TDF science group, the "Barrier Machine S" and "Soul Tab" become available for development in the game.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Valkyria

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The EATER manifested by the Vol that assimilated Kaori Minoshima. It has wings and toys with enemies through swift movement. It can control air pressure at will and has techniques using wind and lightning. Its special attacks include Valstream and Valjavelin.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Windom

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: One of the three Capsule Monsters owned by Dan Moroboshi. It fires a powerful beam from its forehead. Possessor of great strength. It comes from the Metal Planet.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Woo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A legendary kaiju that appeared on Mount Iida. It always appears when the girl called Yukinko is persecuted by villagers, and is said to be the reincarnation of Yukinko's late mother. Covered in pure white fur, its true nature is unknown. Height 40 m, weight 0 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ippei Ueno

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ippei Ueno. A member of MAT. A comical fellow who tends to jump to conclusions and is into astrology. Though all alone in the world, he gets along best with Go.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Communications Officer Ueno

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Handles communications for the Ultra Garrison. He is the first to catch mysterious signals and radio waves from space.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Velvet

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form in which the Bio heroine's Vol manifested when her childhood friend, the Bio hero, faced danger before her eyes. Her weapons include the Velslicer, which attacks by turning the protrusions on her head into blades. She has the Velvet Circle, an application of her hobby of black magic, as a map weapon.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Velvet Fury

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The monstrous form that resulted when the Vol infecting Atefarina forcibly fused with Velvet, the Bio heroine's EATER. Some of Ryoko Sakomizu's lingering thoughts also remain. It is a perfect organism fusing three things: the Bio heroine's human eukaryotic cells, Velvet's archaebacterial cells and the prokaryotic cells of Atefarina's Fusion Steel, but in terms of assimilation it is still

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: incomplete.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Velvet Reverse

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The second stage of Velvet Fury's assimilation. The first stage, Velvet Fury, was a creature, but thanks to Ryoko Sakomizu's lingering thoughts and the Bio heroine's mental stability, she regained Velvet's original form and personality. The only example of an ideal fusion of eukaryotic, archaebacterial and prokaryotic cells. In a sense, this is a kind of miracle.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Vortex

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form in which the Bio hero's Vol manifested. His special attacks include the Volblade, which cuts down enemies by reshaping part of his own body, and the Volcannon, a kind of bio-oscillation laser.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Volhazard

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The EATER manifested by the Vol that assimilated Tatsuya Todo. It has a huge body with enormous heat energy and excels at flame-based attacks. Ferocious by nature and recklessly charging. Its special attacks include Volflame and Volripper.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Volfeed

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The EATER manifested by the Vol cells that assimilated Satoru Hinata. Of all the EATERs it has the strongest urge to assimilate, and is greedy. To survive, it devours the Gigants, the Fusion Steel combat droids. Its weapons include Volsplash and Volcoleda.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ushio

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A UCMA unit member. Boasts remarkable evasion.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Space Sheriff Gavan

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A Space Sheriff dispatched by the Galactic Union Police to stop the space crime organization Makuu's invasion of Earth. With the call "Johchaku", Retsu Ichijouji dons the Combat Suit in just 0.05 seconds. His special attack is the Gavan Dynamic.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Space Sheriff Shaider

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Dispatched as the third Space Sheriff assigned to Earth. With the call "Shoketsu", Dai Sawamura dons the Combat Suit in just 1 millisecond. His weapons are the Video Beam Gun and Laser Blade. His special attack is the Shaider Blue Flash.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: S.Sheriff Sharivan

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The second Space Sheriff dispatched by the Galactic Union Police. With the call "Sekisha", Den Iga dons his Solar Metal battle suit in just 1 millisecond. He boasts a jumping power of 300 m and a running speed of 50 m per second. His special attack is the Sharivan Crash.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Space Jet VTOL

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A Jet VTOL fitted with a space booster, the "hydrogenate rocket engine", allowing it to operate in outer space. Designed by Dr. Iwamoto. In the game, the Space Jet VTOL itself is newly built.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Udesper

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A Desper cyborg who could be called the right-hand man of Fuhrer Geisel of the Desper Army. By removing his arms, he can attach claws, machine guns and more.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Udesper Alpha

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: One of the brother staff officers made from the remains of Udesper after he was defeated by Inazuman. Proud of his strength, he overpowers opponents with brute force, but he is short-tempered and not very bright. His combined technique with Beta, the Cross Hurricane, is tremendously powerful.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Udesper Beta

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: One of the brother staff officers made from the remains of Udesper after he was defeated by Inazuman. He is clever and draws up many plans, but Alpha often holds him back. His combined technique with Alpha, the Cross Hurricane, is tremendously powerful.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Umiumi

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Excels at moving underwater. In the original show, it kidnapped beautiful girls and tried to turn them into mermaids to wait on Kubilai in his "dream paradise".

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ultraseven

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Fixed-star Observer No. 340 from the Nebula M78. He takes the form of Jiro Satsuma, a young man who tried to give his life for a friend, calls himself Dan Moroboshi and fights the alien invaders and kaiju attacking Earth. He transforms with the Ultra Eye. In the game, after 7 turns his energy drains by 80 each turn.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ultra Hawk 1

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The Ultra Garrison's proud large fighter. It separates into three craft, Alpha, Beta and Gamma, for joint operations. Length 42 m, top speed Mach 4. It can also operate in outer space and is armed with laser cannons and missiles. In the game, Alpha, Beta and Gamma sortie separately and can combine on the map. None of them can carry units.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ultra Hawk 2

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The Ultra Garrison's combat spacecraft. It uses jets inside the atmosphere and nuclear-powered ion rockets in space. Length 64 m, top speed Mach 5. The laser cannon in its nose is its main weapon. In the game it can carry one person besides the pilot.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ultra Hawk 3

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The Ultra Garrison's small jet reconnaissance craft. Its uses are many, such as transporting the Magma Riser. The rocket launchers on both sides of the fuselage are its main weapons. Length 19.5 m, top speed Mach 3.5. In the game it can carry one person besides the pilot.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ultraman

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: When he flew to Earth chasing Bemular, he collided with the Science Patrol's VTOL, became one with Hayata and decided to stay and fight on Earth. He transforms with the Beta Capsule, but on Earth he loses energy rapidly and can only fight for 3 minutes. His special attacks include the Specium Ray and the Ultra Slash. In the game, after 3 turns he enters Color Timer mode and his ener

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: gy drains by 80 each turn.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Commander Gonpachi Edogawa

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The top official of EAGLE's Japan Block and Gorenger's commander. He usually poses as the master of Snack Gon.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Eleking

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A space kaiju controlled by the Alien Pitt. The antennae on its head are always spinning. It wraps its long tail around opponents and shocks them with several hundred volts. It also fires a destruction ray from its mouth. Height 53 m, weight 25,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Golden Wolf

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A monster with a golden mane, the form Colonel Zol himself transformed into. He fires missiles from his fingers, and his fangs carry the wolf virus. His body is so hard that it bounces back an ordinary punch.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Daita Oiwa

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The survivor of EAGLE's Kyushu branch, which was destroyed in an attack by Bronze Mask. He transforms into Kirenger. Good with codes, he carries a YTC radio. Curry is his favorite food.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Dr. Otaguro

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Developer of "X-Alpha Fluid", a drug that revives dead creatures and brings them back to life. Shocker targeted his research materials and took his assistant hostage. He later joins the TDF science group, making the "Reload Magazine L" and "EN Repair Kit L" available for development.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Omura

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A UCMA unit member. A rookie only recently assigned. Has lots of room to grow.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Yuriko Oka

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Yuriko Oka. The only woman in MAT. Communications is her main job, but she sometimes fights kaiju too. She holds a 4th-dan in kendo. She also comes from a well-off family. In the game she has repair abilities.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Female Spy

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Udesper's subordinate, known as "the Hound". She approached Goro Watari and told Udesper the location of the secret base. She has been turned into a cyborg and was also called No. 8001. When Interpol secret agent Makoto Arai was wounded, she gave him a part of her own body, the "Diode VS3", and chose death.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kara

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A female monster born from the golden ray emitted from Shadow Moon's left hand. Together with Mara, she always attends at Shadow Moon's side.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Tsuyoshi Kaijo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The survivor of EAGLE's Kanto branch, which was destroyed in an attack by Golden Mask. He transforms into Akarenger.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Fuhrer Geisel

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Leader of the Desper Army, which remodels people with psychic powers into Desper cyborgs and seeks world conquest. He gives orders to his subordinates using chess pieces. A mighty evil psychic, but his right eye is his weak point.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Custom Cyclone

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The Cyclone that No. 2 received from Hongo, strengthened and remodeled. Top speed 400 km/h, with power upped to 600 horsepower. It can jump 40 m and climb vertical walls. It can also travel underwater and fires wire rope from its cowling.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kaimen Green

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Its weapon is the "Kaimen Ball", where it turns its head into a ball and rolls it into opponents. It has an immortal body that reassembles itself even after being torn apart.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: General Guiler

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The action commander who directs Madou's operations. He fights swinging his deadly Lightning Sword and is violent by nature. "Annihilation!" is his catchphrase. In the original show, after repeated failures, there was a time when he was made into a chair at headquarters.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ultraman Jack

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: He became one with Hideki Go, a young man killed in a kaiju attack, and fights kaiju. His time limit while transformed is 3 minutes. He has no transformation device and can transform when Go is truly in mortal danger. He has abilities such as the Specium Ray and the Ultra Barrier. In the game he transforms when HP falls to one third or less.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: He is later armed and strengthened with the Meteor Kick and the Ultra Bracelet.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Flame Fighter

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form Emperor Banba transformed into. He controls flames at will and emits searing 8,000-degree flames.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shiro Kazami

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A biochemistry graduate student at Jonan University and Hongo's junior. Good at gymnastics, he is called "the White Panther of the Mat". Because he helped a witness to Destron, his parents and sister were killed and he was gravely wounded, but Riders No. 1 and No. 2 remodeled him and he became Kamen Rider V3.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Combined Udesper

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form completed by running 2,000 volts through the Udesper brothers and remodeling them into one. Its weapons are the left-hand whip, which can send ten people flying, and the right-hand claws. Even Inazuman struggled against its tremendous 300-horsepower might.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Alien Guts

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An alien who can split into copies, which used Aron to study Ultraseven's abilities and tried to assassinate him. It confuses Seven by splitting itself and has high strategic ability. Apparently it has never lost any battle in the past. Height 2-40 m, weight 200 kg-10,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Katsube

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A UCMA unit member. His Skill is outstanding compared with the other members.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Mecha Commander Gatezone

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The Mecha Commander leading the Kaima Robot Battalion. An expert gunman who never misses his target. He manages all the machinery inside the Crisis Fortress.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shoichiro Kato

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shoichiro Kato. Strictness hides beneath his gentle personality. The decisive, action-oriented captain of the kaiju attack team MAT.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Science Patrol Car

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The Science Patrol's dedicated ground patrol vehicle. It excels at searching, but carries no offensive weapons. In the game too it has no weapons. It can carry up to two people.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ganikomol

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A crab and bat hybrid monster, the first Gel-Shocker monster. Its weapons are the pincer on its left hand and sharp fangs. It also spits a powder that makes humans vanish.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Crab Laser

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form Doktor G transformed into. The scorpion on its head carries deadly poison, its mouth dissolving fluid, its left hand pincers that cut steel, and the lamp on its forehead a laser that can destroy even tanks. It was powered up by the "Ritual of the Devil Warrior's Spirit".

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Great King Gamagon

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The great king of another world, whom Den Iga encountered in the future and met again in the present. It shoots out its long tongue, binds enemies and electrocutes them. It is sensitive to light.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kama Doubler

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Excels at continuous attacks using the Chain Sickle, boomerang sickles and more.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kamebazooka

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A bazooka and turtle hybrid monster. The shell on its back is made of special metal and even repels the Double Rider Kick. It has a large bazooka on its back and sniped at the Riders.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kamen Rider 1

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Takeshi Hongo transforms using the wind power caught by the windmill dynamo in his belt. He uses 48 special techniques to defeat Shocker's monsters. He is later remodeled again into a new form. Also known as No. 1, the Rider of Technique. His machine is the Cyclone.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kamen Rider 1 (New)

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Hongo's Rider, powered up after being remodeled again. True to being No. 1, the Rider of Technique, he has a wide variety of techniques. This remodeling added two lines to his body and turned his boots and gloves silver.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kamen Rider 2

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Hayato Ichimonji transforms into him. Because he has even greater strength than No. 1, he is also called No. 2, the Rider of Strength. He is later remodeled again into a new form. His machine is the Cyclone.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kamen Rider 2 (New)

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ichimonji's Rider, powered up after being remodeled again. True to being No. 2, the Rider of Strength, his power is also enhanced. One line was added to his body, and his boots and gloves turned red.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kamen Rider BLACK

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form Kotaro Minami transforms into with the power of the King Stone. With a 30 m jump, he stands up to Gorgom with the Rider Kick and Rider Punch. His machines are the Battle Hopper and the Road Sector. Gorgom calls him Black Sun.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kamen Rider BLACK RX

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Captured by the new enemy, the Crisis Empire, and cast out into space, Kotaro Minami's King Stone was baptized by the sun's rays, gained new power and became RX. Jump power 60 m. Activating his hybrid energy draws out even greater power. His special attack is the Revol Crash.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kamen Rider V3

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The third Kamen Rider, into whom Shiro Kazami transforms. He has 26 secrets, including a 60 m jump, the Big Sky Kick, the V3 Barrier and the V3 Hopper, and fights Destron's cyborgs. His machine is the Hurricane.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Garagaranda

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form Ambassador Hell transformed into. He can move freely through sand, and his weapons are the right-hand whip that smashes steel and fangs laced with deadly poison. He tried to throw deadly poison into a reservoir.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Calamity

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A robot built by the Republic of Merca, which forcibly demanded the loan of Giant Robo and copied it. It carries an automatic reflection device that repels every attack, and once even blinded Robo. It was stolen by BF's Sparky.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ganger

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A giant flying steel arm. It was after the secrets of the transparent metal QQV and YZ metal. Its grip is so fearsome that it nearly crushed even Giant Robo. In the game it fires missiles from the back of its hand.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Gyeron

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A regenerated kaiju that flew to Earth for revenge from Planet Gyeron, which was used as the testing ground for the planet-attack super weapon R1 and destroyed. Mutated by radiation, it has powerful regenerative abilities. It puts its hands together to emit a ring-shaped ray, and its wings repel the Eye Slugger. Height 50 m, weight 35,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kikaider 01

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: He emerged from inside a Nio statue in response to the evil power filling the world. Ichiro transforms with the call "Change Kikaider, 01". Since his power source is solar batteries, he can barely exert any strength in darkness. His special attacks include the 01 Driver and the Blast End.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Locomotive Mask

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: With an underground structure probe on his feet, he runs all over the place trying to locate Gorenger's base. His specialty is a powerful headbutt, the "Locomotive Heading".

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Gigant

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ground-combat Fusion combat droid: Gigant. A mass-produced organic combat droid that operates unmanned. A four-legged type that boasts high off-road performance and mobility, it fights in melee with Luciferium-alloy claws and with the Luciferium Cutter.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Gigant 2

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An improved version of the unmanned mass-produced combat droid. A system incorporating Vol cells has been newly added. Its armor is higher than the prototype's, making it an even tougher enemy. A four-legged type that boasts high off-road performance and mobility, it fights in melee with Luciferium-alloy claws and with the Luciferium Bullet. More spikes all over its body also make it visually intimidating.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Fumio Kishida

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Fumio Kishida. A MAT member. An intellectual with a strong sense of responsibility, which makes him somewhat inflexible. His uncle is the Director of the Earth Defense Force. He often clashes with Go, who is easily moved by emotion. He worked on developing an ultra-long-range radar, but Akane Hirota, the woman he loved, was an alien whose goal was to destroy the radar.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Chief Kitakura

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Chief of the UCMA special unit. Her real name is Maya Kitakura. Though young, she was promoted to chief of the special unit for her outstanding sense and the trust she inspires. Her father served as a staff officer in the old TDF, but resigned to take responsibility for the NAAGER disaster 15 years ago and is said to have died an unhappy death afterward. She excels in Armor, Accuracy and Evasion, and among the defense officers she is

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: the only one with repair abilities.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Baron Fang

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Destron's second executive. From the Congo. He is also a sorcerer of the Voodoo religion and skilled at curses. He has a helmet harder than diamond and attacks people by launching it. Leading the ferocious Fang Clan, he drove the Riders into a corner. He transforms into the Bloodsucking Mammoth.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Captain Gomez

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A man who has committed every evil imaginable with his subordinate Chief Kid. Brain took him in and appointed him commander of the Brain Party. Full of ambition, he planned to bring even Brain under his control given the chance, but Professor Hustler betrayed him and he failed miserably. He died in an explosion together with the Battleship Robot.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Captain Saller

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A psychic of justice who created the Boys' League, a mutant organization that uses psychic powers for justice. He was quick to see Goro Watari's abilities and scouted him.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Gal 1

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: One of the Gal Corps, Fuuma's five female ninja made up of Gal 1, Gal 2, Gal 3, Gal 4 and Gal 5. A female ninja squad, they are also masters of espionage and swordsmanship. They trap opponents with an electric net.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Gal 2

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Gal 3

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Gal 4

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Gal 5

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Cubrican

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A Kaima Robot sent by Gatezone to eliminate RX. It fires laser beams from its right hand and slashes opponents with the claws on its left.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Cubrican Second Form

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The second form of Cubrican, which rebooted by sprouting a second head after being destroyed. Besides laser beams, it also fires napalm bombs.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kiriyama

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Captain of the Ultra Garrison, Far East Branch of the Earth Defense Force. Always calm and seemingly logical, he is actually warm-hearted. He was in the same military academy class as Captain Kurata of Space Station V3. From Tokyo.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kirenger

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: One of the five warriors of the International Secret Defense Organization EAGLE's Japan branch. Daita Oiwa transforms into him. His weapons include the Key Sticker and the Megaton Headbutt.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Emperor Guillotine

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: He came from the planet Big Fire in the Andromeda Nebula. The leader of BF, who uses his superior science to develop one kaiju and robot after another in his bid for world conquest. His body is a mass of nuclear energy, so he cannot be attacked carelessly.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kingsaurus III

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An ancient kaiju that emerged from the mountains of Hakone. It raises a barrier in front of its body and repelled Ultraman's techniques. It torments opponents by breathing a mist of poison gas from its mouth. Length 105 m, weight 27,000 t. In the game it fires a Shock Ray from its horn.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: King Joe

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A space robot controlled by the Alien Pedan. It splits into four craft to move through the air and sea. It is more powerful than Ultraseven, and its special metal armor repels the Emerium Ray and the Eye Slugger. The Alien Pedan's command saucer is housed in its abdomen. Height 55 m, weight 48,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: King Deviler

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The Iron Mask Party's strongest robot. It flies with Bat Feathers that even repel the Baron Punch, and drove Red Baron into a corner with the Hammer Punch of both arms and the Head Guillotine mounted on its head.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Daisaku Kusama

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A boy who became Giant Robo's only pilot after he was held captive at BF's secret base and happened to give it the start-up command. He later joins the Unicorn Agency and, code-named U7, fights BF led by Emperor Guillotine.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Man Spider

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The first monster the evil secret organization Shocker assigned to its Japan branch. It kidnapped Takeshi Hongo, and later tried to kill Hongo after he escaped. It shoots threads and poison needles that melt humans from its mouth.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Crisis Emperor

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A mysterious despot who, a thousand years ago, suddenly conquered the once green and peaceful Kaima World and founded the Crisis Empire. With the empire on the verge of ruin from heavy-industry pollution, he sent General Jark and the Earth Attack Corps to Earth so his five billion subjects could migrate there. He relays his orders by borrowing Colonel Dasmader's body.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Crusher

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Makuu's low-level combatants. They support the operations of the Beast Monsters and Doublemen, and attack enemies in groups.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Granadas

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A phosphor kaiju controlled by the Alien Centaurus. It has a hard shell, fires destructive phosphor rays from its eyes and breathes flame from its mouth. At one point it even tried to kill Akane, who hesitated to carry out the plan. Height 47 m, weight 25,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Granzairus

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The strongest monster, directly under the Crisis Emperor. It came to Earth to defeat RX. It flies through the air as a fireball and fires destruction rays from both eyes. It boasts a body so sturdy that it repels every one of the Rider's attacks.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Grand Birth

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text
