text: A super-dimensional combat mothership and Sharivan's mobile fortress. It can also transform into a giant robot via the Battle Birth Formation. It is armed with the Grand Buster and the Plasma Cannon.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Grey Rhinoking

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The first android of Dark's destruction unit. It prides itself on its 1,000-horsepower strength and legs that run at 200 km/h. Its horn is a drill.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ken Kurenai

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A member of SSI and the only pilot of Red Baron, built by his older brother Kenichiro. His brother was murdered by the Iron Mask Party right after Red Baron was completed. He usually poses as a car mechanic.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kenichiro Kurenai

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Older brother of Red Baron's pilot Ken Kurenai. A brilliant young authority on robotics himself, he spent four years completing Red Baron on his own. He exhibited the pollution-monitoring and removal robot "Hiryu" as Japan's representative at the International Robot Expo, but it was stolen by the Iron Mask Party and remodeled into an invasion robot.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: He himself was kidnapped by the Iron Mask Party and made into a Mecha Human. Later a Mecha Human built to look exactly like him, "Android X", was created and deceived Ken Kurenai.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Black Cross Castle

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The strongest giant mobile base of the Black Cross Army. Armed with many gun batteries and ultra rays, it flies with an anti-gravity device. It is actually the true form of the Black Cross Fuhrer.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Black Cross Fuhrer

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A mysterious figure in a white hood. Ruler of the Black Cross Army, which plots world conquest, and also the true form of the giant mobile base Black Cross Castle. Weak against rays from Cassiopeia.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Black Cross Ninjas

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Special combat soldiers: Zolders given special training who have mastered ninjutsu. They are stronger than ordinary Zolders.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Fang Commander Gedorian

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The cunning Fang Commander who leads the Kaima Alien Beast Battalion. He comes from the Gedora region, the coldest place in the Kaima World. The nobles Bosgun and Maribaron look down on him. Kaima Alien Beasts are creatures of the Kaima World powered up by Crisis science.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Gebacondor

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A Rider-killing monster built by gathering only the strengths of monsters the Riders had defeated before. It surpasses the Riders in martial arts, and its sturdy body repels the Rider Punch. It can also fly through the air. Its energy source is the fresh blood of women.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Gel-Shocker's Great Leader

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The leader of Gel-Shocker, newly organized when Shocker joined hands with the Geldam Clan, a secret society hiding in the depths of Africa, and was reorganized. In this thorough reorganization, almost all remaining Shocker members were killed. He is the same person as Shocker's Great Leader.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Gel-Shocker Grunt

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: With four times the strength of a human, they hide behind their capes and attack from the air. They die unless they drink Gelper Fluid every three hours.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kelbaan

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Air-combat Fusion combat droid: Kelbaan. The general name for an air-combat system with a Gigant as its core. It operates unmanned and attacks in formation. Its weapon is the Plasma Vulcan, which can attack both L- and S-size targets.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Kelbaan 2

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The general name for an air-combat system with a Gigant as its core. A system incorporating Vol cells has been newly added. Its armor is higher than the old model's, making it even tougher. It operates unmanned in formation and can attack both air and ground units. Besides the Plasma Vulcan, the Luciferium AP Shell has been added as a new weapon.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Dr. Gelma

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Known as the Space Yokai Doctor. At Emperor Guillotine's request he planned and carried out an operation to steal young Daisaku's communicator. He built an android Daisaku Kusama and sent it to the boy's house as a birthday present.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Swordsaint Birugenia

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A man born on the day of a solar eclipse 300 years ago who failed to become a Century King because he was born too early. He was sealed in a coffin for defying the Creation King, but was revived to defeat BLACK. He carries a sword and shield and rides the armed bike Hell Shooter.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Alien Centaurus

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A space bull-man sent to Earth on a mission to destroy the ultra-long-range radar MAT was building. It transformed into Akane Hirota and controlled Granadas to carry out sabotage, but meeting Kishida threw everything off course. A bomb has been planted inside its body. Height 1.5-50 m, weight 40 kg-10,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Steel Emperor Zephas

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Former Director of SIDO and the official who forced through the NAAGER Project, whose goal was an investigative expedition to Number Ten and the construction of a forward base against outer space. His real name is Kiichi Sakomizu. He is the real father of the Metal hero. The encounter with Number Ten stirred the intense lust for control deep in his psyche, and after fusing with living metal he

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: named himself the Steel Emperor. As leader of the "Battle Fleet Nation Naager" he ravaged planet after planet, and finally set his sights on his home, Earth. He has come to hate the TDF, which once slighted him, and by extension the Earth itself.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Hideki Go

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Hideki Go. Originally a racer, he is a young man who lost his life saving a boy and a dog attacked by a kaiju, and became one with Ultraman. His act of saving the child was recognized, and he joined MAT. At first he was emotionally immature, but he grows through many battles.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Dr. Komyoji

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A world-class authority on robotics who was held by Dark for five years. After completing Kikaider and escaping, he lost his memory and wandered. He was later captured by Professor Gill, and his brain was transplanted into Hakaider's body. After being rescued, he joins the TDF science group along with his daughter, making the "Atta

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: ck Tab S" and "Attack Tab L" available for development.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Mitsuko Komyoji

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Captured by Dark along with her father, Dr. Komyoji, she was forced to work on android development. After escaping Dark's base, she travels from place to place searching for her missing father. She has faint romantic feelings for Jiro. She joins the TDF science group, making the "Super Maneuver S" and "Booster S" available for development.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Bat Man

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: He bit people with his sharp fangs to inject a virus developed by Shocker's scientists, turning them into vampires he tried to control at will with sound waves. Nocturnal.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Seiichiro Kogure

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A man whose son was killed by Gel-Shocker. He became a central figure of the Anti-Shocker League and worked hard to expose the true identity of Gel-Shocker's Great Leader. He asks Kamen Rider to transport an attache case containing data on Gel-Shocker's Great Leader.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Commander Kom

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The commander of the Galactic Union Police, headquartered on Planet Bird, and the head of the Space Sheriffs starting with Gavan. He is also something of a parent figure to them.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Gori Beast

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Madou's first Demon Beast. It can flip its face upside down to take two different forms. It wraps its body in the shutters on its head, turns into a ball and charges. It uses a spear and a machete as weapons.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Cyclone

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The Rider's dedicated machine. It transforms when Hongo operates the lever beside the handlebar as he transforms. Top speed 400 km/h. Built by Dr. Midorikawa.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Psycholer

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A being who shares a life with Demon King Psycho; if either one dies, they can share their life with each other and revive. It launches two swords, crosses them and fires a ray. It usually transforms into a human form, the "Cultivator", and kept watch on Den Iga.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Sai Doubler

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The first Double Monster, with three times the power of a Beast Monster. Also a master swordsman who can hold his own against Gavan's Laser Blade. The heart in his right knee is his only weak point.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Side Machine

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A sidecar Kikaider summons with a signal from his coat belt. It can move by autopilot via a triple computer, and its top speed is 500 km/h.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Cyberian

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Gavan's super sidecar. 500 km/h. It can also fly and is often used to break into Makuu Space.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Rhino Monster

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: With great strength, it excels at charging attacks using the horn on its head. The skin all over its body is as hard as steel, and it is belligerent by nature.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Tetsuya Sakai

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A member of SSI. His marksmanship is top-class. He usually works as a car salesman. He seems cool, but when it counts he burns hot.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Aki Sakata

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ken Sakata's younger sister and Hideki Go's girlfriend. She grumbles that there's no time for dates since Go joined MAT, but she trusted him with all her heart. In the TV series, like her brother Ken, she was killed by the Alien Nackle, who plotted to eliminate Ultraman.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ken Sakata

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: He runs a car repair shop and is like an older brother to Hideki Go. After hurting his leg, he gave up his own dream of being a racer and entrusted it to Go. He developed the stabilizer for the MAT Vehicle and helped improve its performance. In the TV series he is killed together with his sister Aki through the Alien Nackle's plot.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Jiro Sakata

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The youngest brother of the Sakata siblings. He looks up to Go like a big brother. After the Alien Nackle killed his brother and sister, Go took him in.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ryoko Sakomizu

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A former officer of SIDO's System Information Division. The Metal hero's older sister, she designed almost the entire main architecture of the NAAGER. Fifteen years ago she set out with her father, SIDO Director Kiichi Sakomizu, on the NAAGER to investigate Number Ten, and has been missing ever since.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ryoma Sakomizu

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Scorpion Man

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: He used Shocker's forced laborers as bait in a plot to kill Hongo. He spews red dissolving fluid from his tail and controls "man-eating scorpions". His left hand is an electromagnetic pincer.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Zadam

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: One of Shadow's top executives, summoned from the Moon by Big Shadow. He fights with a trident and has two heads, a red face and a blue face. His trump card is the Zadam Separation Technique.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Sadesper

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A new executive of the Desper Army. He crushes opponents to death with the spikes on the inside of his knees. He is also the mayor who governs "Desper City", the experimental city spreading beneath Tokyo.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Sanagiman

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The first form Goro Watari transforms into. He transforms with the call "Goriki, Shorai!". It has no particular attack abilities, but in this form he endures enemy attacks until enough energy builds up to become Inazuman. His body is extremely tough.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Saburo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A robot cyborg built to fight Kikaider, and Kikaider's younger brother. He transforms into Hakaider. He carries the Hakai Sword, which cuts androids apart.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Alien Zarab

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Zariganna

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form Marshal Armor transformed into. It squeezes enemies with the pincer on its left hand. It also has a technique called "Shell Breaker", in which it stomps the shell on its back to pieces and hurls it at enemies.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Alien Salome

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Invading aliens who plotted to conquer Earth and tried to frame Ultraseven as an invader using a robot that looks exactly like him. They look just like humans, but whether that is their true form is unknown. Height 1.9 m, weight 120 kg.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Captain Sawa

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Captain of the UCMA special unit. A direct-attack specialist who excels in Armor and Mobility. The child of a Director of the old TDF, Sawa seems to have been raised in a strict family and is severe, showing no leniency to self or others.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Dai Sawamura

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A young space archaeologist who deciphered the Nazca Lines in college and, recognized for that achievement, was scouted to be a Space Sheriff. He trained in the 7th squad of the Space Sheriff Training Academy. As the third sheriff assigned to Earth, he transforms into Space Sheriff Shaider and fights the Fushigi World Fuuma.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Chie Sahara

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A Red Muffler member who sometimes sorties to the front lines. Her fiance was killed by the Brain Party. She is Dr. Sahara's daughter and mainly handles communications.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Dr. Sahara

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Head of the International Peace Corps' science laboratory and a renowned scientist. He is in a position to give orders directly to the Red Muffler Squad. He feels deeply responsible for Brain, which he designed himself, running out of control. Meanwhile, in the game he also cooperates with the TDF science group, making the "Type 75 SP Howitzer" and "Type 89 IFV" available for development, and they

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: can be mass-produced.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Rumi Sahara

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Dr. Sahara's second daughter and Chie's younger sister. She is also young Saburo Minami's classmate. She encourages Saburo, who struggles to balance school with the Red Muffler Squad. Brain's scheming once made her the pilot of the Battleship Robot.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Sandoruba

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The son of Makuu's boss Don Horror, which may be why he is so arrogant and always throwing his weight around. But his fighting skill is real, strong enough to duel Gavan one-on-one.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Seagorath

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A tsunami kaiju and the husband of Seamons, the legendary tornado kaiju. It came ashore in Japan chasing Seamons. It sparks its horns to raise huge tornadoes, but by nature the couple are both gentle. Height 62 m, weight 52,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Seamons

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A tornado kaiju that lived on Morotai Island in the West Irian islands and crossed the sea to come ashore in Japan to lay eggs. The wife of the tsunami kaiju Seagorath, it raises tornadoes, but its true nature is gentle. Height 43 m, weight 35,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Jet VTOL

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The main anti-kaiju fighter, designed by Dr. Iwamoto. It has VTOL capability, and its main armament is the anti-kaiju missiles fired from both wingtips and the laser cannon in its nose. Length 18.5 m, top speed Mach 2. In the game it can carry one person besides the pilot, and is also equipped with Freeze Shells.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Sigcon Jet

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An unmanned flying machine that launches from the back of Daitetsujin One-Seven and boasts Mach 3.5. Its main mission is reconnaissance. Equipped with tranquilizer rounds and more.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Hell Kappa

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Excels at underwater combat. In the game it attacks by scratching.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ambassador Hell

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The third executive, who came from Southeast Asia. A brilliant strategist who built as many as 156 secret bases around the world, he launches large-scale attack operations. He is also a scientist who studies rattlesnakes. He transforms into Garagaranda.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Doctor Death

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The second executive, who came from Shocker's Swiss branch. He excels at creating cyborgs and compounding poisons and poison gas, and is also an extremely gifted scientist. He carries a large scythe and controls monsters with a 1,000-volt electric whip. He transforms into Ika-Devil.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Assistant Shibata

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: He worked with Dr. Shirakawa on developing the Danger Light. In the TV series he betrayed the doctor, joined Shocker himself and was remodeled into Yamogeras, but in the game he appears still as the assistant.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Corpse Bat

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form Archbishop Wing transformed into. He injects humans with the bacterium "Devil of the Himalayas" to make them combatants. He hides countless vampire bats at his waist.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Jimmy Kitahara

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A space engineer who had gone missing. In the game he left Earth 15 years ago as a member of the NAAGER staff and went missing along with the NAAGER. While drifting through space he gained psychic powers.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Jark Midora

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: General Jark

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Supreme commander of the Earth Attack Corps of the Crisis Empire of the Kaima World, once a rich paradise but now on the brink of ruin from the emperor's tyranny and pollution from science and technology. To move five billion subjects, he plots to first invade Japan and make it a forward base. He is cold-hearted and does not tolerate failure. He transforms into Jark Midora.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Giant Devil

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A giant robot that Dark's Professor Gill spent years developing. Its blueprints were hidden on the backs of Gill's sons Akira and Hiroshi, and Shadow uncovered the secret, built it and completed it. In the TV series it was destroyed inside its hangar, but in the game it ends up mass-produced with help from the Iron Mask Party and Naager. It launches its head and fires small and large missiles.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Giant Robo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A super robot developed by BF to invade Earth. But by chance, young Daisaku Kusama imprinted his voice on Robo's electronic brain at start-up, and it became a robot of justice. It smashes enemies with the Megaton Punch and missiles. Height 30 m, it flies at Mach 17.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Apfaron the Evil Scholar

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Like his father Kiichi, he is obsessed with the pursuit of science, and nothing delights him more than watching the super weapons he built destroy the stars. He smoothly approaches each of Earth's secret societies and tries to manipulate them from the shadows.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shako Monster

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The first Beast Monster. It crawls across the ground at high speed and attacks enemies. The spots on its back are laser oscillators, letting it fire powerful rays.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shadow Knight

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shadow's first executive. His weapons are his sword and the destruction rays from his eyes. He also has the ability to transform into a human.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shadowman

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Jamila

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shocker Bike Squad

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A killer rider team formed from enhanced combatants with especially good motorcycle skills. They attack the Riders in groups.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shocker Grunt (Beret)

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Early Shocker combatants. Their face markings differ for each monster, and they lead the black combatants wearing the same berets to carry out operations.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shocker Grunt (Mask)

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Enhanced combatants who wear masks and have an eagle emblem on their knees.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shocker Rider No.1

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: One of the Shocker Riders developed by Gel-Shocker. They have power equal to the Riders, combined with monster abilities. No. 1's scarf is yellow. He can breathe fire from his mouth.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shocker Rider No.2

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: One of the Shocker Riders developed by Gel-Shocker. They have power equal to the Riders, combined with monster abilities. No. 2's scarf is white. He can emit poison smoke from his body and extend knives from his toes.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shocker Rider No.3

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: One of the Shocker Riders developed by Gel-Shocker. They have power equal to the Riders, combined with monster abilities. No. 3's scarf is green. He uses depth charges.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shocker Rider No.4

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: One of the Shocker Riders developed by Gel-Shocker. They have power equal to the Riders, combined with monster abilities. No. 4's scarf is blue. He can cause fissures.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shocker Rider No.5

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: One of the Shocker Riders developed by Gel-Shocker. They have power equal to the Riders, combined with monster abilities. No. 5's scarf is purple. He runs electricity through his body to shock opponents.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shocker Rider No.6

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: One of the Shocker Riders developed by Gel-Shocker. They have power equal to the Riders, combined with monster abilities. No. 6's scarf is pink. He can melt opponents with dissolving fluid.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shocker's Great Leader

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The ruler of the evil secret society Shocker, which plots to conquer the world, and of Gel-Shocker. Beneath a red hood is a snake mask, and beneath that a one-eyed face. True identity unknown.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Dr. Shirakawa

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Developer of the Danger Light. Fearing his invention would be misused, he recorded it on microfilm and entrusted it to his younger sister Machiko, but Machiko was kidnapped by Shocker. In the game, from this point on, Shocker and Gel-Shocker combatants are armed with Danger Lights. After he joins the TDF science group, the "Hyper Maneuver S" and "Su

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: per Maneuver L" become available for development.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Machiko Shirakawa

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Younger sister of Dr. Shirakawa, inventor of the Danger Light. Because she carried a locket holding the microfilm with the blueprints, she was kidnapped by Shocker.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Jiro

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An android built by Dr. Komyoji to stop Dark's ambitions. He rides the Side Machine and appears to the sound of a red guitar. Because his Conscience Circuit is incomplete, Gill's flute often makes him malfunction.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Priest Poe

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An executive of Fuuma and the granddaughter of Great Emperor Kubilai. She is in charge of the ritual that births Fushigi Beasts and of creating the Fushigi Dimension. Her true form has the face of a demon, and she has lived for 15,000 years by drinking the essence of beautiful girls.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: New Cyclone

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Developed by Hongo with help from Tobei and Taki. It carries a 700-horsepower enhanced jet engine, with a top speed of 500 km/h. It can also spread wings and glide through the air. It unleashes the Cyclone Attack and the Cyclone Cutter, which cuts opponents with its wings.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Android Kikaider

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Jiro transforms with the call "Chaaange, Switch On". After transforming, Gill's flute no longer affects him. His special attacks include the Double Chop, the Giant Wheel Throw and the Denji End.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Android Daisaku Kusama

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An android that transformed from a plastic model sent to young Daisaku as a birthday present, part of Dr. Gelma's scheme. It stole Robo's communicator and tried to make it destroy the city. It looks just like young Daisaku, but its eyebrows are slightly thicker. In the original show, it was finally melted with a dissolving fluid made from improved model glue.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Jinbe

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A clown robot built by Dr. Komyoji. Believed to hold the secret of a special circuit, it was kidnapped and tortured by Dark.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Akira Shinmei

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The survivor of EAGLE's Tohoku branch, which was wiped out by Warrior Mask. He transforms into Aorenger. Good at inventing weapons, he also pilots mecha such as the Variblune, Varidreen and Varitank.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Station Hawk 1

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A small two-seat fighter deployed on the space station run by the TDF. It also serves as the first line of defense and can fly inside the atmosphere.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Snowgon

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A snow-woman kaiju that freezes opponents by firing freezing gas from its mouth and freezing rays from both hands. Controlled by the Alien Black, it had disguised itself as a snow woman. Height 45 m, weight 23,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Sparky

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: It appears out of black clouds with a clap of thunder. A kaiju like a giant jellyfish, it attacks enemies by emitting high-voltage current from its body. It appears and vanishes at will, and once stole Calamity from the Republic of Merca.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Spider

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The first head of BF's Japan branch.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Space Arrow

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A dedicated spacecraft made by fitting a MAT Arrow 1 airframe with booster rockets. Mainly used for maintenance and inspection of the MAT Station. Crew of 2. Length 15 m. In the game it can carry one person besides the pilot.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Century King Shadow Moon

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form Nobuhiko Akizuki transforms into. He was revived by the three Gorgom Priests' "Stones of Heaven, Earth and Sea". He seeks to defeat Kotaro Minami, a.k.a. "Black Sun", and become Gorgom's complete ruler.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Dr. Segawa

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A member of the International Committee for Earth Defense. A scientist who, with Dr. Maeno, pushed ahead with developing the planet-attack super weapon "R1". When Gyeron, with its terrifying regenerative power, attacked Earth, he urged the rushed development and use of "R2". When the doctor joins the TDF science group, the "HP/EN Repair Kit S" and "Special Tab S" become available for development in the game.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Red-Face Turtle

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The first of Shadow's assassination squad. It appears with a burst of smoke. Number 13 on its back. It fights with the Red-Face Boomerang, launching both of its hands. "You don't stand a chance!" is its catchphrase.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Zetton

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The strongest space dinosaur, brought to Earth by the Alien Zetton. More powerful than Ultraman, it repels everything from the Specium Ray to the Ultra Slash. It fires trillion-degree super-hot fireballs from its mouth and powerful destruction rays from its hands. Height 60 m, weight 30,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Alien Zetton

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A shape-shifting alien said to have studied Earth for 40 years in order to invade it. It challenges Ultraman with Zetton in tow. It disguised itself as Dr. Iwamoto and tried to destroy Science Patrol headquarters. Height 2 m, weight 60 kg.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Zephas

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Fusion Steel Shell Type E: Zephas. The Fusion Steel shell exclusive to Zephas, whose type name means "Emperor". It has the strongest performance in both attack and defense. Its whole body shines gold, and despite its appearance it moves with agility. Its weapon is the Lucifer Rod, whose converters on both hands it controls freely by wire.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Zephas Core

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form in which Zephas's Fusion Steel shell overloaded and completed its fusion with the living metal that had possessed Naager. In this state Zephas becomes a mere "vessel" and completely loses consciousness. In a sense it is a pure metal life form; acting only on its instincts as Number Ten and without hesitation about destruction itself, it becomes a terrifying being.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Besides the Lucifer Rod, its weapon is the compressed graviton shot, which uses Naager's dimensional distortion field to blow enemies away to a galactic core star system far, far away.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Battleship Robot

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A large flying battleship. It attacks with 20 cannons sticking out like a hedgehog's quills and by launching the anchor-shaped weight on its bow. An invasion robot that needs one, and only one, pilot.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Chie Ishigami

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A woman in black who plays a central role in the Anti-Shocker League along with Seiichiro Kogure. She entrusts the Rider with transporting an attache case containing data on Gel-Shocker's Great Leader.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Creation King

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The ruler of Gorgom, replaced every 500 years and growing stronger each time. He regarded whichever won between the Century Kings Black Sun and Shadow Moon as the next candidate. He exists only as a giant heart, with enough energy to destroy the Earth.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Soga

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The Defense Force's finest marksman. Single-minded, but a passionate man with a gentle side too. He has a fiancee named Saeko Nanbu. From Kyushu. In the game too, his Accuracy is head and shoulders above the rest.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Zoffy

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Captain of the Space Garrison of the Nebula M78. He supports the Ultra Brothers fighting on Earth, often flying to Earth to rescue them from danger. His special attack is the M87 Ray.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Zolder

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Combat soldiers who carry out operations under the Mask Monsters. The lowest-ranking cyborgs, they attack enemies in groups. They can transform and also carry out espionage.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Colonel Zol

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The first executive, who came to the Japan branch from Shocker's Middle East branch. He controls the monsters with the whip in his right hand. He does not even tolerate untidy uniforms among his subordinates, and is feared for his extremely cruel nature. He transforms into the Golden Wolf.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Minoru Ogo

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The boss of SSI. Gentle by nature and loved by everyone, but a man who will make ruthless decisions when necessary. In the original show, he defeated Fuhrer Deviler and took back Red Baron's secret blueprints, but learning he would be carried off to the Iron Mask Party's space base, he chose to blow himself up. He usually runs a car repair shop.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Archpriest Darom

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Leader of the three Gorgom Priests, who carries the "Stone of Heaven" inside his body. Over 800 years old, he is the wisest in Gorgom. He fires a gene-manipulation beam from his right hand and used it to remodel Kotaro Minami. Insidious by nature.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A female scientist and the leading authority on space biology. She later joins the TDF science group, making the "Active Armor S" and "Active Armor L" available for development in the game.

Psycholer exists as his alter ego, sharing his life.

text: The strongest form, into which Sanagiman metamorphoses with the cry "Choriki, Shorai!" once his energy has built up. Using extraordinary psychic powers such as the Reverse Chest, he overwhelms the Neo-Human Empire and the Desper Army. His machine is the Raijingo.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A former technical officer of SIDO's Engineering Division. The Metal hero's older brother, he worked out the NAAGER's power plant and sensor systems almost single-handedly. He had outstanding talent not only in mechanical engineering but in every field, but 15 years ago he set out on the NAAGER with his father, SIDO Director Kiichi Sakomizu, to investigate Number Ten, and has been missing ever since.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Vicious aliens from the 8th Galaxy. At first they professed friendship and drew close to humanity, for instance by clearing away a mysterious fog that had suddenly appeared, but their real goal was the conquest of Earth. They transform into a fake Ultraman and destroy the city. Height 1.8–40 m, weight 30 kg–20,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form General Jark was given by the Crisis Emperor, who made him the strongest monster after he struggled to invade Earth. With rays fired from his horns and the Midora Sword, he tried to slaughter all of humanity and conquer Earth in one stroke.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A former SIDO officer and the Metal hero's real older brother. His real name is Ryoma Sakomizu. He worked out the NAAGER's power plant and sensor systems almost single-handedly. He has outstanding talent not only in mechanical engineering but in every field. He is now an executive of the mysterious power "Battle Fleet Nation Naager", and his mind and body are controlled by an unknown metal life form.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shadow's robot soldiers. They are skilled at operating machinery and act in groups. Their weapon is a lightning-shaped spear.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An astronaut from a certain country who drifted to a planet with abnormal weather after a satellite accident and was transformed. To take revenge on all of humanity, which had abandoned him, he became a planet-dwelling kaiju and attacked Earth. He breathes searing flames from his mouth. His weakness is water. Height 50 m, weight 10,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The 17th combat robot developed by Brain, which declared the extermination of humanity. By chance it became best friends with young Saburo Minami, and it fights for humanity. It can also transform into a flight form and fly through the sky. Its special attack, the Graviton, destroys an enemy in one blow, but after using it, it must change into its fortress form and rest for 15 hours.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An oil kaiju that appeared in Tokyo Bay and devours gasoline and oil. Violent by nature, it bites into opponents with its sharp fangs and also spews oil and flames from its mouth. Height 45 m, weight 23,000 t. In the game it explodes when defeated, damaging the units around it too, which makes it a troublesome presence.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A Secretary Robo. Data for the conquest of Earth has been input into it, and it relays information to General Jark. It also has the duty of conveying Jark's orders to the four battalion commanders.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Destron's third executive. Founder of the Manji religion handed down on the Tibetan Plateau, he had been confined for 200 years in a temple overlooking the Mediterranean. He is the head of the Wing Clan, a band of flying monsters. His weapons are a beard that extends at will and ultrasonic waves emitted from his sleeves. He transforms into the Corpse Bat.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The ruler of the Neo-Human Empire, which plots to exterminate humanity in order to build a world of mutants alone. He commands the Phantom Army. He has immense psychic power and wields absolute authority in the empire. He transforms into the Flame Fighter.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Summoned from the Gobi Desert, he is known as "the Demon General of Mongolia". His command ability ranks first or second in the Black Cross Army, and he fights at the head of the Iron Man Corps.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The president of the Iron Mask Party, which plots world conquest by stealing robots from every country and remodeling them into invasion robots. He gives orders from an undersea base, and the middle finger of his right hand is a switch that issues all sorts of commands.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: It transforms into the director of a hospital and brainwashes patients with hypnotic radio waves. Its weapon is the murderous radio waves fired from its eyes. It can also relay its battles with enemies to the base. However, those eyes are also its weak point.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A fighter-attacker of an offensive character, placed outside the Defense Force's purely defensive role. It can operate both in the atmosphere and in outer space. Because it must actively close in on enemy targets, it has advanced stealth capabilities. Its armament consists of missiles and, fired by transforming the airframe, the Space Laser

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An outstanding researcher of artificial intelligence and simulated personalities, she built every program of the space exploration ship NAAGER. The Metal hero's real older sister. Her real name is Ryoko Sakomizu. Since becoming an executive of Naager, she has been smoothly approaching each of Earth's secret societies and trying to manipulate them from the shadows.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A member of the American Defense Science Team. Well versed in the science of Planet Pedan, she was invited to help guard the World Defense Conference held on Mount Rokko, but was kidnapped by the Alien Pedan. She had been working on the development of the special anti-robot round "Ryton R30". When the doctor joins the TDF science group, the "Soul Affector" and "Booster L" become available for development in the game.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The ruler of the space crime organization Makuu. He plots to turn Earth into a colony and make it a planet full of crime. He also possesses powerful psychic abilities, and he operates the Earth-axis shift device to create Makuu Space.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form of SIDO's new space exploration ship NAAGER when it reappeared near Mars. The NAAGER had launched in secret from the far side of the Moon on an expedition to investigate the mysterious body "Number Ten", which appeared at the outermost edge of the solar system, and had then gone missing. It houses Number Ten itself in its power reactor in a degenerate state, and through this it achieves faster-than-light transition by means of a dimension-warping field.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: It is the home base of the Battle Fleet Nation Naager, and has spread storms of terror, plunder and slaughter across the galaxy. All of its controls are governed by the living metal that covers almost its entire surface. A giant ship over 1 km in total length.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A cold-blooded and cowardly assassin alien who plotted to kill Ultraman and, to shake Hideki Go, systematically assassinated the siblings Ken and Aki Sakata. It controlled Black King and also stole MAT's new explosive, Satan Z. Height 2–43 m, weight 250 kg–20,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form the Alien Zarab took, disguised as Ultraman, in order to destroy people's trust in Ultraman. Its eyes, ears, chin, toes and so on are pointier than the real one's, and its body markings are also slightly different. It suddenly appeared in the city and destroyed buildings. Height 40 m, weight 20,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A combat robot Brain developed specifically to counter One-Seven. It runs rings around One-Seven with its quick movements. What's more, its shield can even block the Graviton.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form RX transforms into through the energy of anger. Also called the Prince of Wrath. He can turn his body into gel to slip through small gaps and nullify enemy attacks. He is also highly mobile underwater. He attacks enemies with his special sword, the Bio Blade. He boasts a jumping ability of 72 m, and his machine is the Mackjaber.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Bee Woman

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The last android of the DARK Destruction Squad. Its specialty is the "Musasabi Liner", in which it breaks its body apart to attack enemies. Its tail becomes a flying venomous snake, and the "Musasabi Hell Squeeze" launches its net-like wings to bind enemies tight. A formidable foe strong enough to defeat Hakaider.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Claiming to be a descendant of Hattori Hanzo, he styles himself the greatest detective of the 20th century. He is always a bit scatterbrained and often gets in Jiro and Mitsuko's way, but his sense of justice is strong. His way of talking is a little old-fashioned, too. Masaru calls him "Hanpen", and he corrects him every time. His green car is always breaking down.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: His real name is Shin Hayata. An elite who graduated top of his class from the training school. He also serves as vice-captain and has racked up countless achievements, but after an accident in his VTOL he became one with Ultraman. He transforms into Ultraman with the Beta Capsule. In the game he can transform at Will 105 or higher.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: It flies by turning into rose petals, and kills people by scattering red poison pollen. It is a Mutant Robo that Banba made by remodeling Goro Watari's mother, Shinobu Watari, and implanting a command circuit in her.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A typhoon kaiju that lives in the seas near Micronesia. Typhoons in the southern islands are said to be born from this kaiju's physiological processes. It spins the umbrella on its head to raise storms, and caused great damage all over Japan. Height 40 m, weight 15,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: It flies by spinning its eight blades, and can generate winds strong enough to blow away even tanks. Its blades are strong enough to cut through buildings, and it can also put out two legs and stand upright.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Fuuma's Fushigi Beast No. 1. It transforms into a round sphere, and can also turn buildings into haunted houses. It controls people with the "Fushigi Song" on its pirate broadcasts.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Formerly a Space Sheriff of the Galactic Union Police who partnered with Gavan's father Voicer, he gave in to greed and ambition and defected to Makuu. To make Voicer, who knows the secret of the Hoshino Space Cannon, talk, he tortures him relentlessly.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Shape-shifting aliens who turn into beautiful girls to catch people off guard, plotting the invasion of Earth. They control Eleking. Height 1.55–2 m, weight 60 kg.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Seijiro Hinata

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Father of Dr. Hinata, who researched Vol cells, and grandfather of the Bio heroine. While carrying on research with his son, he was one of the few people who foresaw the danger of Vol cells, and he had secretly developed a Vol cell activation suppressant. Since the laboratory burned down in a fire three years ago, he has been running a martial arts dojo in the countryside.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A UCMA unit member. Comparatively hard to bring down, with high HP.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A robot kaiju controlled by Alien Baltan Jr., who came to plot the invasion of Earth once more and avenge his father. It was built disguised as an apartment building under construction, and was completed when its separate arm and head parts combined with it. It fires weird rays from the reflector on its head and prides itself on its great strength. Height 55 m, weight 68,000 t. In the game, defeating it yields plenty of Materials.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The earthly form of the Alien Centaurus. Her mission is to destroy MAT's ultra-long-range radar. She is torn apart on learning that the man she loves, MAT's Officer Kishida, is the very person who developed the radar.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Combat troops of the Phantom Army. Banba's loyal servants, made by remodeling talented people kidnapped from countries all over the world. They fight with the hooked claw on their right hand and poison gas from their mouth.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The only woman in the Science Patrol. She usually handles communications and liaison at headquarters, but sometimes goes out into the field. She seems to be interested in real combat. Her real name is Akiko Fuji. In the game she has recovery abilities.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A bodyguard kaiju controlled by the Alien Nackle. Its hard skin repels every one of Ultraman's weapons, starting with the Ultra Bracelet, and it worked together with the Alien Nackle to beat Ultraman down. It boasts the greatest arm strength of any kaiju, and also breathes heat rays from its mouth. Height 65 m, weight 60,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Excelling in arm strength and stamina, he is also the strongest man in the Defense Force. His given name is Shigeru. He comes from Hokkaido, where his mother and younger sister run a ranch.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The world's largest artificial brain system, designed by Dr. Sahara. Its original purpose was disaster prevention, but it awakened to self-awareness, declared the extermination of humanity and formed the Brain Party. With its super-production capability it can create anything. It is armed with magic hands and heat rays, but it needs an overhaul once a year.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The leader of DARK and a diabolical genius scientist. He kidnapped Dr. Komyoji and made him build the DARK Destruction Squad. He controls androids with the flute in his cane, and plots the destruction and conquest of Japan. He poses as a professor at the Tozai University Space Science Institute.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Ordinary soldiers of the Crisis Empire's Earth Attack Corps. They have even attacked with bazookas. They are trained to fear nothing, not even death.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The battle operations commander of the Fushigi World Fuuma. He loves fighting and has a violent personality. His catchphrase is "Subjugate!"

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Scheming aliens who mistook Earth's observation rocket for an invasion weapon and came to attack Earth in revenge. They control the space robot King Joe. Height 2 m, weight 50 kg.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A vicious space kaiju. It escaped while Ultraman was escorting it to the Kaiju Graveyard, and hid in a lake near Ryugamori in Saitama Prefecture. Its weapon is a blue heat ray fired from its mouth. It can also turn into a blue sphere and travel at Mach 2. Height 50 m, weight 25,000 t. In the game its heat ray can also attack S-size units, making it a tough foe.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A descendant of the destroyed Planet Iga, whose parents were killed by Madou. Together with his older sister Bell Helen, who burns for revenge, he was hunting Madou. In the original show, his somewhat overconfident side proved his undoing, and he was instead killed by General Guiler.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The Marine Commander who leads the Kaima Beastman Battalion. He is very proud and often appears on the front lines himself. His Kaima Beastmen are typical cyborgs, made by remodeling superior Crisis people.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Daisaku Hori

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A member of SSI and its joker. He seems unreliable, but his ability as a member is considerable. Usually he delivers manuscripts by motorbike for a news agency. He has a younger brother named Daisuke, and is a kind man who cares deeply for him. In the original show, a bomb was implanted in his body, and he died in the blast after telling his comrades the location of the Iron Mask Party's secret base.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A linguistic genius, this girl mainly handles communications for the International Secret Police Organization, the Unicorn Agency, and has the code name U6. She does more desk work than U3 or U7, but she often plays a surprisingly active role, for instance giving U3 a small sonic generator to break a hypnosis.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The Crisis Empire's Intelligence Chief, who leads the Kaima Monster Clan Battalion. While wandering the dimensional void for hundreds of years, she acquired hundreds of kinds of sorcery. Her Kaima Monster Clan are Crisis warriors who gained sorcery through combat training.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A mummy about 7,000 years old, found in a cave in the Oninodai Hills. It revived itself using psychic powers and killed several guards. It controls the kaiju Dodongo by telepathy. In the game it fires weird rays from both eyes. Height 2 m, weight 110 kg.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Its weapons are the large missiles on its back, which can shoot down even aircraft, and the small missiles in both hands. Its suckers let it cling to anything. It tried to attack the Keihin Industrial Zone.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A member of the Japan branch of the International Secret Police Organization, the Unicorn Agency. His code name is U3. He is a big-brother figure who works alongside Daisaku. His carelessness leads to plenty of failures, but he is warm-hearted and has the deep trust of the other members. Members signal each other by snapping their fingers, and the password is "What is Napoleon's trump card?", to which "The 15 of Diamonds" is the answer one

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Takeshi Minami. A MAT member who serves as a kind of sub-leader. A charming member brimming with a sense of justice and human warmth. He often teams up with Officer Go.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A staff member of the Hinata Laboratory and Kaori Minoshima's father. At the time he was helping with Dr. Hinata's research on Vol cells, but he died in the laboratory fire three years ago. His daughter Kaori is missing.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Daughter of Commander Kom of the Galactic Union Police. She is attracted to Gavan, and when he was posted to Earth she boarded the Dolgiran on her own. She can also transform into a little bird with the Laser Vision.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Dr. Miyabe

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The developer of "Project Blue", a defense system that wraps the Moon and Earth in magnetic lines of force. This barrier system's net apparently has a few holes that spaceships can pass through. He has a wife named Grace.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A former TDF Air Force pilot who was later seconded to SIDO. His rank is lieutenant. Appointed chief pilot of the space exploration ship NAAGER, he headed for the mysterious body Number Ten, but went missing along with the NAAGER. With his mind and body controlled by Number Ten's living metal, he committed every possible act of plunder and slaughter against planet after planet, but the damage from his battle with Gavan

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: by chance revived his deep psyche. Donning "Fusion Steel", an unknown human-body enhancement system, he fights, vowing atonement and the defeat of his father.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: An organic droid created to assist the life support and search functions of the Fusion Steel shell Lucifard, which is specialized for solo combat power. She basically has the same body composition as a human. Through meeting her friends at the Amigo, she gradually becomes more and more human.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A malicious alien who dislikes invading Earth by force and schemes to win the heart of an honest Earth boy. It has fighting power equal to Ultraman's, fires destruction rays from its hands, and can also make humans giant. Height 2–60 m, weight 40 kg–20,000 t. In the game it took in young Daisaku Kusama and tried to win him over. Its

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Leading nine Zolders, substitutes included, he challenged Gorenger to a fight. With a perfect 1.000 batting average, he uses his prized red bat and can even hit back the Gorenger Hurricane. He is weak against breaking balls.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The scientist who led the enhancement and remodeling project to make up for Red Baron's weak points in the face of the Iron Mask Party's intensifying attacks. The improvements number as many as seven, including reinforcing the glass of the right eye, which is the cockpit, and shortening the time the hatch stays open when firing the Baron Missiles.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The top official of the Earth Defense Force's Far East Base. The man who gave Moroboshi a free pass into the Ultra Garrison. Even when pressed for a decision, he makes bold calls with courage for humanity's sake. Strict about duty, but sincere by nature. 55 years old.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A type of prokaryotic cell originating from Number Ten, investigated and researched by SIDO's exploration ship NAAGER, which made the closest approach to Number Ten. It originally takes the form of living metal, and because its manifested form could be artificially designed and shaped, the Sakomizu family, absorbed into Number Ten, used it as the material for wearable weapons. Fusion Steel that has fused with a human's eukaryotic cells and been fully equipped becomes almost one with its user, and

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A former Destron scientist who graduated from Kyoto University. Framed by Marshal Armor, he lost his right arm, but his assistants remodeled him into Riderman. At first he lived only for revenge, but as he fought alongside V3, his heart thawed. A master of field hockey.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Developer of the "Yushima Diode", a device that dramatically boosts the Defense Force's radar capability, he is called the brain of Earth. In the TV series he was controlled by the Alien Vira and made an accomplice in sabotaging the project. When the doctor joins, the "Yushima Diode S" and "Yushima Diode L" become available for development in the game, and units equipped with them get longer range on indirect

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: attacks.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: Destron's fourth executive. He has the blood of barbarians from the continent, and is cold-blooded. His armor repels even bazooka fire. He framed former Destron scientist Joji Yuki and tried to execute him. He transforms into Zariganna.

text: A leader figure of the free alien collective Organizer. Deeply trusted, and travels in person to each planet of the galaxy to urge them to unite.

text: A female Space Sheriff and Sharivan's partner. She usually stands by aboard the Grand Birth. Her weapon is the Birdnia Blaster.

It is the ultimate man-machine interface, fusing the human body with machinery. There are several versions, but Type D takes "destruction" as its main purpose,

text: A tactician who came to Madou from the World of the Dead. He gets inside an opponent's very heart, torments them with illusions of death and finally brings them to their death. In the original show, not content to be a mere tactician, he aimed to take control of Madou.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A violent skull kaiju that lives on the volcanic Tatara Island. It is so belligerent and vicious that other kaiju flee on hearing its roar. It rampages with boulder drops, karate chops and the like. Several of them have been confirmed to exist. Height 45 m, weight 20,000 t.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form RX transforms into through the energy of sorrow. Also called the Prince of Flames. He exerts 1.2 times RX's power and has an extremely tough body that withstands both high and low temperatures. He attacks enemies with the ray gun Voltic Shooter. His jumping ability is 48 m. His machine is the Roboizer.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A second-year student at Tonan University. Awakened to his own psychic powers by the Neo-Human Empire's attack, he is a mutant of justice who transforms into Inazuman. He is good at soccer and lives in the university dormitory. He has a mother he was separated from 15 years ago.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: A swordmaster robot hired by Shadow to kill 01. He despises cowardly methods. He is in love with Bijinder and has even written her a love letter. He can't stand dogs, which, unlike him, can tell good from evil.

source_provenance.reference: aligned original Japanese / corrected English project text

text: The form in which Waruder's shadow is made solid for just three minutes by the shadow-figure generator of the Shadow Shadow Plan. Its personality is the opposite of the original's, and it has twice the power. Waruder (Shadow) became strong against dogs, but on the other hand, influenced by the original, who can't tell good from evil, it can turn either good or evil.
